description: This header file declares internal functions used by the CCSP Scalar Helper object in the SNMP Agent platform, including functions for removing, loading MIBs, registering handlers, and managing MIB values and cache.

methods.name: CcspScalarHelperRemove
methods.description: Removes or cleans up the scalar helper object.

methods.name: CcspScalarHelperLoadMibs
methods.description: Loads MIB modules using provided XML and library handles.

methods.name: CcspScalarHelperRegisterMibHandler
methods.description: Registers MIB handlers with the SNMP agent.

methods.name: CcspScalarHelperGetMibValues
methods.description: Retrieves MIB values for SNMP requests.

methods.name: CcspScalarHelperSetMibValues
methods.description: Sets MIB values based on SNMP requests.
